## Architecture Overview

The `List` method on `dynamic.ResourceInterface` returns `(*unstructured.UnstructuredList, error)`. Changing to `(PaginatedList, error)` breaks all code that accesses `.Items`, `.GetResourceVersion()`, or uses the `*unstructured.UnstructuredList` type directly.

## Detailed Analysis

### Helm

- **`pkg/engine/lookup_func.go`** (line 83) — `obj, err := client.List(context.Background(), metav1.ListOptions{})` then `obj.UnstructuredContent()`. Directly uses UnstructuredList.

### ArgoCD

- **`cmd/argocd/commands/admin/backup.go`** — Multiple `.List()` calls (lines 100, 108, 114, 122, 226) iterating `.Items` slice for secrets, projects, applications, applicationSets.
- **`gitops-engine/pkg/cache/cluster.go`** (line 722) — `res, ierr = resClient.List(ctx, opts)`, checks `res == nil`, accesses `res.GetResourceVersion()`.
- **`applicationset/generators/duck_type.go`** (line 123) — `duckResources, err := g.dynClient.Resource(duckGVR).Namespace(...).List(...)`, accesses `duckResources.Items`. Function signature takes `*unstructured.UnstructuredList`.
- **`cmd/argocd/commands/admin/admin.go`** (lines 47-51) — Resource fields as `dynamic.ResourceInterface` type.

### Grafana

- **`pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/resources/retry_client.go`** (lines 228-241) — `List()` method returns `(*unstructured.UnstructuredList, error)` explicitly.
- **`pkg/services/apiserver/client/client.go`** (lines 39, 118) — `K8sHandler` interface defines `List()` returning `*unstructured.UnstructuredList`.
- **`pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/resources/client.go`** (lines 53-54) — `ResourceClients` interface returns `dynamic.ResourceInterface`.

## Relevant Files

|------|-----------|-----|
| helm | pkg/engine/lookup_func.go | dynamic List() call with UnstructuredContent() |
| argo-cd | cmd/argocd/commands/admin/backup.go | Multiple List() calls iterating .Items |
| argo-cd | gitops-engine/pkg/cache/cluster.go | List() with GetResourceVersion() access |
| argo-cd | applicationset/generators/duck_type.go | List() with *unstructured.UnstructuredList param |
| argo-cd | cmd/argocd/commands/admin/admin.go | dynamic.ResourceInterface type fields |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/resources/retry_client.go | List() method returning *UnstructuredList |
| grafana | pkg/services/apiserver/client/client.go | K8sHandler interface with List() |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/resources/client.go | ResourceClients returning dynamic.ResourceInterface |
